messages:
Maya Chen: Quick design review — compact roles + invite pathway. Main asks: where should SSO enforcement toggle live, and how do we surface audit log navigation for org admins? Screenshot in thread.

Rajesh Patel: Thanks. My leaning: SSO toggle should be in a global 'Security' row, not per-role. Keeps invite flow simpler. Also want clear state when SSO is enforced for the org (+ tooltip).

Olivia Torres: Agree re: global. UX nit: current toggle sits inside roles grid header and collapses visual hierarchy. Proposal: move toggle out as a persistent pill next to the 'Org settings' header, with color/icon for enforcement state. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/roles-invite

Samir Noor: Implementation concerns: moving out means a separate display surface vs grid controls. Can we keep the toggle control in the DOM near the grid but visually place it in the header? Also need focus order — keyboard nav must reach it early.

Maya Chen: Good point. We also need the toggle to be read-only for users without 'manage-sso' permission. UI should show disabled state with a tooltip 'Insufficient permissions'.

Olivia Torres: Copy suggestion for tooltip when SSO enforced: 'SSO is enforced for this org. Contact an admin to change.' For disabled controls: 'SSO enforced — invites limited to SSO users.' Thoughts?

Rajesh Patel: +1 on copy. Also audit log nav — currently buried under 'More actions'. Admins asked for a direct link. Could be a small 'View audit log' link in the header that opens the audit page filtered to invites & RBAC changes.

Samir Noor: Backend-wise we can deep-link with a query param like /audit?filter=rbac_invites. Frontend will need to generate that link and add aria-label 'Open audit log (invites & role changes)'.

design-bot: Accessibility check: proposed pill color (#5B6FFF on white) fails AA for small text. Need contrast >= 4.5:1. Toggle must also expose role='switch' and aria-checked. Ensure focus ring is visible.

Maya Chen: Good catch. Olivia — can you propose alternative color or an outline treatment? Also add keyboard shortcut hint for power users.

Olivia Torres: Options: darker primary #3B4DCC or outline + bold label. I'll add a focus style (2px ring, visible label) and include a screen-reader-only 'Skip to audit log' link. Updating Figma now.

Rajesh Patel: Timeline ask: can we do design update this sprint and ship dev next? Dev estimate: frontend ~2-3d, backend deep link ~1d, QA accessibility checks ~1d.

Samir Noor: Confirming 3d frontend + 1d backend. Will pair with Olivia on a11y tests. I'll also add an e2e: 'SSO toggle focus + audit deep link'.

Maya Chen: Action items: Olivia — updated frames + copy; Samir — backend deep link + aria attrs + e2e; Rajesh — add story to sprint and prioritize review. I'll run a quick sync tomorrow.

Olivia Torres: Uploaded updated frames and left comments on the components (see Figma link). I changed pill color to #3B4DCC and added an outlined variation for small viewport.

Samir Noor: I'll start a branch and stub the deep link API. Will request review once frontend styles are in.

Rajesh Patel: :thumbsup: Thanks all — looks actionable.

Maya Chen: :rocket:
